blocked_sentences: • RadAway — Target player loses all rad counters. Sacrifice this artifact

needs.what: rad as a player counter kind (a PlayerState field plus an entry in player.PLAYER_COUNTER_KINDS, with the rad trigger at the beginning of precombat main phase), and a way to remove all counters of ONE named kind from a target player (e.g. a `counter` option on lose_all_player_counters, or a player-targeted remove_counters)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: lose_all_player_counters removes every player counter kind (poison and energy) rather than only rad counters, so it would also strip the target's poison and energy; PLAYER_COUNTER_KINDS carries only poison and energy, so rad counters do not exist; remove_counters acts on objects, not players
